notes.title: Played Our Game? Share Your Experience!
notes.content:
Have you enjoyed our game? We’d love to hear what you think! Your reviews help us improve and reach more gamers like you.

If you've had a great time defending your towers, please take a moment to leave a review. Let us know what you loved, what could be better, and how the game has challenged you.

[h3]Connect With Us[/h3]
Whether you're seeking support, tips for conquering levels, or just want to chat about all things VR, we invite you to join our community:

notes.title: Towers & Powers VR: New Game Modes
notes.content:
We are glad to announce a major update to Towers & Powers VR! We've added five new game modes to enhance your gaming experience. 

Complete any level, and the new modes will be unlocked for that level:

[list]
[*] Weak Foundation
[*] No Buildings
[*] Midas Curse
[*] Manastorm
[*] Strained Workforce
[/list]

Dive in, have fun, and don't forget to share your results in the new modes with the community!
Happy defending and enjoy the adventure!

notes.title: Towers & Powers VR: Exciting Fixes and New Game Mode Coming Soon!
notes.content:
It has been over a month since the release of Towers & Powers VR, and we couldn't be more grateful for the overwhelming support and positive response from our amazing community. We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who took the time to rate and review our game on the Playstation Store and Steam. Your feedback has been invaluable to us, motivating us to continue striving for excellence.

Our team has diligently examined all the feedback received. We are excited to share that we are actively working on implementing fixes for some of the issues that have been most requested by our community. Smooth turning and free movements are among the improvements in the pipeline, and we are eager to bring these enhancements to you in the near future.

But that's not all! We’re working on bringing an amazing twist to your gameplay with the introduction of a brand new mode. This mode promises to elevate your tower defense in VR experience, making it even more fascinating and unique. We can't wait for you to explore this addition and further enhance your adventure in the Towers & Powers VR universe.

Once again, thank you for your incredible feedback and enthusiasm. Stay tuned for the upcoming updates, and let's continue this fantastic journey together!

Sincerely,
The Towers & Powers VR Development Team

notes.title: Celebrating One Week Since Launch!
notes.content:
[h2]A Heartfelt Thanks![/h2]
It's been a week since we launched, and we've been thrilled to see players donning the god gloves to embark on this adventure. A huge thank you to everyone who has joined us on this journey!
The past two years of development have been a labor of love, and it's incredibly rewarding to watch Content Creators and VR Enthusiasts immerse themselves in the world we've created. We're eager to hear your feedback and suggestions as we continue to improve the game.

[h2]Game Highlights[/h2]
As you venture through the game, you'll encounter a diverse array of levels and formidable foes, all while defending your realm and its inhabitants. Each challenge is designed to test your skills and provide an epic VR experience.
While we are proud of the extremely positive feedback we've received across various platforms, we'd love to see your support reflected here on Steam. Your reviews are invaluable to us; they enhance our visibility and help us reach more players. Remember, reaching 10 user reviews will feature us in the Discovery Queue, introducing our game to even more potential heroes!

[h2]Connect With Us[/h2]
Whether you're seeking support, tips for conquering levels, or just want to chat about all things VR, we invite you to join our community:
Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/KNPxVUk8Wm]https://discord.gg/KNPxVUk8Wm[/url]
Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/jetdogs]https://twitter.com/jetdogs[/url]
Your engagement and enthusiasm mean the world to us. Let's continue this incredible journey together!
